headline: What About Oil Deliveries to Poland? Orlen Issues a Statement
summary: Orlen has contracted 16 additional oil deliveries since Friday for refineries in Poland, the Czech Republic and Lithuania. The group cited the situation on the global commodities market.
why: Orlen is Poland's state-controlled integrated oil group, operating refineries and fuel retail across Central Europe. Its crude sourcing decisions affect regional fuel supply and prices.

impacts.name: Orlen
impacts.why: Orlen is securing additional crude deliveries for its refineries, which affects its supply costs and throughput.
